description: This Scala source file defines the RebaseDateTime object containing functions and data structures for rebasing dates and timestamps between hybrid (Julian + Gregorian) and Proleptic Gregorian calendars, used in Spark versions 2.4 and earlier versus 3.0 and later.

classes.name: RebaseDateTime.RebaseSpec
classes.description: Defines rebase operation mode and origin time zone.

classes.name: RebaseDateTime.JsonRebaseRecord
classes.description: Represents JSON records with rebasing info for microseconds.

classes.name: RebaseDateTime.RebaseInfo
classes.description: Stores rebasing switch points and differences in microseconds.

methods.name: rebaseDays
methods.description: Performs rebasing of days between calendars based on switch points and differences.

methods.name: localRebaseJulianToGregorianDays
methods.description: Converts Julian days since epoch to Gregorian days, handling pre-Common Era dates.

methods.name: rebaseJulianToGregorianDays
methods.description: Optimized rebasing of Julian days to Gregorian days using pre-calculated arrays.

methods.name: localRebaseGregorianToJulianDays
methods.description: Converts Gregorian days since epoch to Julian days, handling pre-Common Era dates.

methods.name: rebaseGregorianToJulianDays
methods.description: Optimized rebasing of Gregorian days to Julian days using pre-calculated arrays.

methods.name: loadRebaseRecords
methods.description: Loads rebasing info from JSON files into a HashMap.

methods.name: getLastSwitchTs
methods.description: Finds the latest switch timestamp where calendar differences become zero across time zones.

methods.name: rebaseGregorianToJulianMicros
methods.description: Converts microseconds from Gregorian to Julian calendar with optional time zone handling.

methods.name: rebaseGregorianToJulianMicros
methods.description: Overloaded version using system default time zone.

methods.name: rebaseJulianToGregorianMicros
methods.description: Converts microseconds from Julian to Gregorian calendar with optional time zone handling.

methods.name: rebaseJulianToGregorianMicros
methods.description: Overloaded version using system default time zone.
